title: Baobab Organisation Drift, Audit Lineage and Metrics (ADR-BCP-018 gate ORG-15)
description:
Definition library for ADR-BCP-018 sections 127-131: relationship drift (in ADR-BCP-008's drift model, sections 14-16), the audit lineage of an Organisation, and the catalogue of organisation metrics.
Validate resources against fragment URIs (e.g. #/$defs/RelationshipDriftFinding), not the document root.

Invariants:
  Drift is reported for review; relationship changes never trigger blind cascades (section 129), so no finding is auto-repairable.
  Findings, audit entries and metrics carry identifiers, never organisation names or registration identifiers (sections 125, 130).
  Metric labels are bounded vocabularies; tenant, organisation and relationship ids are never labels (ADR-BCP-008 section 44).

Control Plane is the runtime authority. Shared is the contract authority.

driftRule.description: The relationship invariant a finding violates. Extensible by a versioned contract change.

driftType.description: ADR-BCP-008 section 15 drift types used by organisation drift.

driftSeverity.description: ADR-BCP-008 section 16. Severity reflects impact: CRITICAL can change platform classification or access, DEGRADED leaves a live link to something no longer active, WARNING and INFO need tidying.

RelationshipDriftFinding.description: One actionable relationship drift (ADR-BCP-018 section 128), shaped after ADR-BCP-008 section 14. It is observed, not stored: rerunning detection on unchanged state yields the same findings.

resource_id.description: Opaque id of the drifting record (e.g. a prel_ or tom_ id).

tenant_id.description: Present when the drifting record is tenant-scoped.

related_resource_ids.description: Opaque ids of the records the drift is measured against, e.g. the ended basis relationship.

observed_state.description: What is live now, in state vocabulary only (no names).

remediation.description: Relationship drift is resolved by governed review, never by cascade (section 129).

truncated.description: True when more findings exist than were returned.

OrganisationAuditEntry.description: One audited change in an Organisation's lineage (ADR-BCP-018 section 131): who changed what, when, under which correlation, and on what evidence. Returned only to privileged administrators; the payload may carry evidence references but never evidence binaries.

payload.description: The audited change as recorded; identifiers, states, reasons and evidence references.

organisationMetric.description: ADR-BCP-018 section 130 metric names, exposed in Prometheus form. Gauges report current counts; counters (the *_denied, *_failure, *_review and *_reclassification totals) count events since process start. corporate_group_derivation_total counts derivable CorporateGroups by derivation status (CURRENT, PENDING, RETRYING); membership is derived state kept current by the Control Plane (gate ORG-05).

organisationMetricLabel.description: The only label names organisation metrics may carry; each takes values from a bounded contract vocabulary.
